long_description: We are a Y Combinator / Latitud backed financial health focused micro-lending platform in Mexico led by people from companies such as Capital One, Bain, Konfio, DiDi etc. We are hyper focused on making sure our users understand and improve their financial health through their relationship with us. In a very short time, we have achieved significant traction with very good consumer outcomes and unit economics. We have built a solid AI foundation in product development, data science and lending operations that powers our product. Our goal is to build the biggest AI enabled financial health platform in Mexico and eventually LatAm.
name: BelozFi
one_liner: Financial health focused micro-lender in Mexico
